title: Noor and the Safehouse
author: Kestrel Nystrom
blurb: Lena Vane, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
